instruction: How many hours does the battery of HP Pavilion 15 Laptop last? Please answer as per its amazon reviews or questions/answers and and only trust information from its verified purchasers.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: evaluation demands no database changes and only the answer. All amazon APIs used (search_products, show_product_reviews, show_product_questions, show_product_question_answers) are public and take no access_token, so no login / show_account_passwords step is modeled. The product id and the battery question id are discovered at runtime (known-id). Both verified reviews (is_verified=true) and verified Q&A answers must be consulted before completing; the hours answer object is bound at runtime from the retrieved text and passed as the `answer` argument of supervisor.complete_task, which is forced to be the last action.
